--- title: "Design Matrix for interaction effects" date: "2025-02-06" description: "Matrix Algebra" categories: [code, analysis] --- ## Design Matrix for interaction effects Problem discussed with Niklaus Meier (Thank you.) Assume we want interaction terms of continuous variables (variables in $\mathbf{X}$) with categorical variables (variables in $\mathbf{J}$). The corresponding Design Matrix is the **Transposed Khatri-Rao Product**; this is a **row-by-row Kronecker product** of two matrices. $$ \mathbf{J} \bullet \mathbf{X} = \begin{bmatrix} \mathbf{J}[1,] \otimes \mathbf{X}[1,]\\\hline \mathbf{J}[2,] \otimes \mathbf{X}[2,]\\\hline \mathbf{J}[3,] \otimes \mathbf{X}[3,]\\\hline ...\\\hline \mathbf{J}[n,] \otimes \mathbf{X}[n,]\\ \end{bmatrix} $$ # Dummy Matrix $J$ and Matrix $X$, Parameter vector ::: {.cell .column-page} ::: ::: {.cell .column-page} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [,1] [,2] [1,] 0 1 [2,] 1 0 [3,] 1 0 [4,] 1 1 [5,] 1 0 [6,] 0 1 [7,] 0 0 [8,] 0 1 [9,] 1 1 [10,] 0 0 [11,] 1 0 [12,] 0 0 [13,] 1 1 [14,] 1 1 [15,] 1 0 [16,] 1 1 [17,] 0 1 [18,] 1 0 [19,] 0 0 [20,] 0 0 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [,1] [,2] [,3] [,4] [1,] 12 8 12 10 [2,] 12 8 12 9 [3,] 7 11 10 10 [4,] 9 8 9 6 [5,] 6 11 13 8 [6,] 6 13 7 8 [7,] 11 10 10 12 [8,] 9 12 10 9 [9,] 10 11 10 9 [10,] 10 9 8 13 [11,] 10 10 12 12 [12,] 12 10 13 12 [13,] 12 11 9 13 [14,] 10 10 10 12 [15,] 7 10 11 12 [16,] 6 12 12 11 [17,] 10 9 8 10 [18,] 10 10 9 4 [19,] 8 11 12 11 [20,] 5 10 13 12 ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell .column-page} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [,1] [1,] -0.3441 [2,] -1.9380 [3,] -1.0247 [4,] 0.5453 [5,] 0.6501 [6,] 0.7426 [7,] -1.9414 [8,] 1.1564 ``` ::: ::: # Design Matrix: Transposed Khatri-Rao product This is a **row-by-row Kronecker product of two matrices** ::: {.cell .column-page} ::: # Alternative ("by hand") ::: {.cell .column-page} ::: {.cell-output-display}
